en.html:
Night had become properly late; bedtime had come. Then only Konatsu finally asked.

Since leaving that place, not one word between us. Homeward walk, goodbye to Tadayasu, food, bath: all completed. Apparently a human being could finish his entire evening without having anything to say to the other human being doing it with him. Very efficient. Next we could become cupboards.

Uncle and Auntie we did speak to. We were not exactly distributing sunshine, either of us, and they noticed. But luckily it did not reach the questioning stage. Everybody kept their own worry. No need to serve extra portions around the table.

If we had come home beaten and injured, of course, different matter. A face cannot say nothing happened while its nose is pointing toward a different district.

Tadayasu ka kya? Thinking of that, I was a little worried about him.

en.html:
That was what burned. One day only, but I had trusted that man.

Meri galti. My mistake. Expectations I had made myself, put them in his hands myself, and now I was standing there furious that he had dropped them. Wonderful arrangement. All the work I do, and still somebody else gets to disappoint me.

Fine. Understood. Understanding had arrived; anger was refusing to vacate. Both would have to fit in the same head. At least I could turn that head forward. Forget him. Start again. Our own strength, our friends' strength. Trust that, like before.

Bas. That would do.

From the beginning, what else did we have?

I answered and yawned.

Tired, yes. Body and mind both. Which one was heavier, I was in no condition to conduct a competition. Body would have to carry mind to the competition, mind would complain about the journey, and I would be stuck taking both of these useless fellows home.

Let her leave the doorway. Then straight onto the futon, and probably no further movement until morning. This was my entire ambition now. People wanted glory, wealth, a name that would live forever. I wanted horizontal.

But she was not leaving. Doorway occupancy continued.

en.html:
For some time I just stared at the closed doorway.

Then I looked right, looked left, looked at the ceiling and scratched my nose.

No hidden spies I was looking for. Matlab, suspicious behavior only. A little while ago I had been qualified to diagnose this in other people. Now see. Same disease, and not even the excuse of a spy.

Then onto the futon, and sleep.

Somehow the weight on body and mind had become a little less. She had come here, explained that a scarecrow was doing better work than me, and left me feeling lighter.

Ajeeb. Treatment I did not understand. But no need to call her back for a second dose.
